title: 3gqi.2.2.2: Wire GNSS peripheral to Python NMEA generator via Renode monitor
description: Connect the C# peripheral (3gqi.2.2.1) to the Python NMEA generator (3gqi.2.1) via Renode's external interface or file injection. The Python generator writes NMEA to a pipe/file, the C# model reads and forwards to UART. This replaces static playback with dynamic position/time generation.
